decision_rationale: The paper presents MAMMAL as a pretrained multi-task foundation model over large biological datasets, with explicit sequence-to-sequence and encoder-decoder autoregressive support. The abstract and model section show both generation capability and broad pretraining across proteins, small molecules, and omics.
evidence_snippet: "supports classification, regression, and generation tasks"; "supports both encoder-only and encoder-decoder autoregressive modes"; "pretrained using six diverse datasets spanning multiple domains"; "multi-task foundation model"; "learns from large-scale biological datasets across diverse modalities"
